title: The artificial skylight that you won't believe isn't real
summary: A short look at CoeLux, an artificial skylight that recreates the scattering process that makes the sky look blue, producing a convincing illusion of distant sun and depth.
why: HN points to it as a demonstration of artificial daylight, especially for windowless or underground rooms, and to date the technology to 2014.

quote.text: If anybody wants to see a cool artificial light that mimics natural light well take a look at coelux
